import { Cluster, Menu, Select } from "@hackcove/ui-react";

  <Cluster as="ul">
    <Menu key="menu" label="Actions" items={[{ label: "Edit", onClick: edit }]} />
    <Select<string> key="pick" label="Pick" items={items} />
  </Cluster>
);
